mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_product_review (order_id, order_item_id, spu_id, sku_id, user_id, rating, content, images, sku_spec, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{spuId}, #{skuId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{skuSpec}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_product_review WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.spu_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.sku_spec, r.status, r.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM t_product_review r INNER JOIN t_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.spu_id = #{spuId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.rating = #{rating} ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(rating), 1), 0) AS avgRating, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star5Count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star4Count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star3Count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star2Count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star1Count FROM t_product_review WHERE spu_id = #{spuId} AND status = 1

SELECT oi.id AS order_item_id, o.order_no, oi.spu_id, oi.spu_name, oi.sku_spec, oi.image, oi.price, oi.quantity, o.finish_time FROM t_order_item oi INNER JOIN t_order o ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_product_review r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status = 3 AND r.id IS NULL ORDER BY o.finish_time DESC, oi.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.spu_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.sku_spec, r.status, r.create_time, s.name AS spu_name, s.main_image AS spu_image FROM t_product_review r INNER JOIN t_spu s ON r.spu_id = s.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id DESC
